text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Setup PowerShell
      uses: actions/setup-powershell@v1
    - name: Install required modules
      run: |
        Set-PSRepository PSGallery -InstallationPolicy Trusted
        Install-Module -Name Pester -Force
        Install-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -Force
    - name: Run PSScriptAnalyzer
      run: |
        $errors = Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse -Severity Error
        if ($errors) {
          Write-Error "ScriptAnalyzer found errors:"
          $errors | Format-List
          exit 1
        }
    - name: Run Pester Tests
      run: |
        $result = Invoke-Pester -Path . -PassThru
        if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0) {
          Write-Error "Some tests failed"
          exit 1
        }
    - name: Validate file endings
      run: |
        $files = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Include "*.ps1", "*.psm1" | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 0 }
        foreach ($file in $files) {
          $content = Get-Content $file.FullName -Raw
          if ($content -notmatch '\r\n$') {
            Write-Error "File $($file.FullName) does not end with single blank line"
            exit 1
          }
        }
```
